profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software developer and systems architect with over a decade of experience building and scaling software solutions across cross-functional teams in manufacturing, e-commerce, healthcare, and gaming. I’ve worked on everything from complex enterprise systems to high-performance applications, always focused on delivering reliable, maintainable code that solves real business problems.
 
Currently, I’m deeply involved in local AI orchestration and workflows. My focus is on creating cost-effective, highly reliable systems that run 24/7 with minimal overhead; keeping infrastructure lean while producing consistent, high-quality results without relying on expensive cloud APIs.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description: Work on a variety of projects through software development contracts to deliver features and solve problems for clients. At the same time, I’ve been focusing on upskilling through hands-on work and learning new technologies particularly in the AI orchestration as it applies to the software development lifecycle and local AI use.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Leads end-to-end development of best-in-class SaaS solutions, overseeing projects from concept to delivery while ensuring compliance, scalability, agile processes, reliable engineering, and user-friendly functionality. Define technical strategy and architecture, driving robust, efficient software innovations, and operational excellence. Mentors engineers, conducts code reviews, and collaborates with cross-functional and international teams to align with business objectives and elevate team performance.

positions.title: Systems Design Architect
positions.description:
• Led software development team and architecture for enterprise data, processes, automation, and integrations.
• Implemented company-wide agile software team metrics, and lean and kanban work management.
• Consulted on system architecture, REST APIs, product roadmaps, team reviews, and software
development life cycles (SDLC) and DevOps pipelines.
• Delivered projects in a lead capacity for new APIs, financial, manufacturing, shipping services, and
general IT projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed manufacturing execution system (MES) application and service integrations, successfully launching new manufacturing, shipment, RMA, consumer product, and payment services.
• Deployed scalable, asynchronous event architecture to integrate multiple Corsair business units, connecting incoming ERP system with MuleSoft and Oracle.
• Administrated Jira and Confluence for software work and project management, project documentation, work automation, and service requests.

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
• Developed new customer support features and responsive pages for Magento 2 eCommerce website.
• Implemented automated bug tracking and Git change control for multiple software applications.
• Optimized PHP and MongoDB application framework speeds.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained SaaS client website management, live instructional video and news feeds, and information mailing services for healthcare professionals, doctors, and patients.
• Led transformation of mailing service, custom PHP framework for customer management portal, recurring invoice and payment integrations, and customer ticket support system.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · PHP · Software Design · Web Application Development · PHP Applications · Back-End Web Development · Microsoft Office · Integration Testing · JavaScript · Non-Functional Requirements · Requirements Analysis · SQL · Microsoft Excel · Software Development

positions.title: Technology Manager
positions.description:
• Developed and managed multiple iOS and OS X apps with a total of 1.5 million downloads on the iTunes Store such as Mouth Mover, Chuck the Bot, and TunePad.
• Engineered patented method of video distortion filtering to remove manual work required to process legacy media transfers.
• Oversaw the creation and maintenance of company website, in-app purchase content server, and mailing server.

positions.title: Distance Learning Student Assistant
positions.description: Developed online orientation, registration, and conference web applications utilizing PHP, JavaScript, and SQL. Created/maintained websites and provided administrative and technical support for department.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Microsoft Office · JavaScript · SQL

positions.title: Sales Specialist
positions.description: Created recommendations for customers on technology purchases. Inventoried and organized floor room merchandise.

positions.title: Community Manager
positions.description: Directly managed game forums, chat, and help tickets to enforce policies and settle disputes. Published official game communications and content. Assisted development team with game design and documentation.

projects.title: Laravel LaunchDarkly Integration
projects.description: Allows easy Laravel integration with the LaunchDarkly service to implement feature flagging.

projects.title: Laravel Power BI Report Embed
projects.description: Allows easy embedding of Power BI reporting in your Laravel application using the Power BI JavaScript framework.
